news.title: Man hospitalized after shooting at Buckhead apartment complex
news.summary: A man is recovering in the hospital after being shot in the leg during a dispute in Buckhead early Wednesday morning.

news.title: Man arrested in Ponce De Leon Avenue death accused of murder
news.summary: Atlanta police and FBI agents arrested a man Tuesday wanted in connection with a June homicide outside a Ponce De Leon Avenue restaurant.

news.title: Man barricades himself inside southwest Atlanta home, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police are negotiating with a 53-year-old man barricaded inside a bedroom at a southwest Atlanta home.

news.summary: After the collision, the people involved began arguing, and the woman called her boyfriend to the scene.

news.title: Wanted man flees moving SUV, caught after Forsyth County manhunt
news.summary: A traffic stop in downtown Cumming escalated into a manhunt after a driver ran from a moving vehicle, according to the Forsyth County Sheriff's Office.

news.title: 1 dead, 3 hurt in shooting inside apartment in Atlanta's Vine City neighborhood
news.summary: One person was pronounced dead at the scene.

news.title: 1 dead, 3 injured in downtown Atlanta apartment shooting, police say
news.summary: Multiple people have been shot, and one person is dead in downtown Atlanta near the Mercedes-Benz Stadium on Tuesday afternoon, according to police.

news.title: Canton man charged with malice murder in death of 2-year-old
news.summary: A 22-year-old man was arrested and charged with malice murder and child cruelty after a 2-year-old died in Canton. An autopsy is pending.

news.title: Man in wheelchair critically injured in Atlanta hit-and-run crash
news.summary: A 69-year-old man is fighting for his life in critical condition after a hit-and-run driver struck his wheelchair on Lee Street SW early Tuesday morning.
